Resolves #18791

🌿 A workflow can no longer be counted as a guard's mirror while its filter watches less than the guard reads: the allowlist `check-guard-ci-parity` credits is now held to the surface it credits, and a guard that declares nothing cannot hide in the denominator.

`check-guard-ci-parity` deliberately credits any `paths:` allowlist, and its source says why — *"it is an alignment question, and until that predicate exists an allowlist is credited"*. This is that predicate. A filter narrower than the surface it credits is a false green of the exact class that lint exists to catch, one layer in: the workflow exists, the guard counts as mirrored, and an edit in the uncovered region never re-runs it.

It could not be written because it had nothing to read. Of the ten mirrored guards, five exposed a scan surface (under two names) and five kept it module-private. **All ten already knew what they read** — the blocker was naming, not knowledge, which is why this closes in one change rather than ten.

Evidence: **L1** — the predicate driven over the live population, each arm measured green-at-head and red-under-a-seeded-drift.

## AC Evidence

| AC | |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | every declared member is tracked — `git ls-files -- ':(glob)<member>'` over the whole population. **Red-first proven:** restoring `ai` to `check-jsdoc-types` reds it, naming `check-jsdoc-types.mjs → ai/**/*.mjs` |
| AC-2 | every **tracked file** of a surface is selected by some mirror, with each mirror's `paths:` evaluated as GitHub evaluates it — patterns in order, `!` excluding, last match deciding, unmatched files not selected. **Red-first proven:** narrowing `theme-coverage-lint.yml` to one theme dir reds it with `245 tracked file(s) no mirror re-runs on, e.g. resources/scss/src/Global.scss` |
| AC-3 | the drift control is the pure `uncoveredFiles()`, seeded by dropping or negating a pattern rather than by editing a workflow, so the arm asserts on its own. Three arms pin the ways a green here could be manufactured: a `!` carve-out that selects nothing, a depth gap, and last-match-wins plus per-mirror isolation |
| AC-4 | the denominator: every mirrored guard exports `SCAN_SURFACE`. **Red-first proven:** un-exporting `check-class-module-scope`'s reds it, naming the guard. The population is **derived** — `lint-staged` minus the registry's `clientOnly` rows — via a new `mirroredGuards()` export, so a guard that gains a mirror enters these arms in the same edit |
| AC-5 | `check-jsdoc-types` no longer claims `ai`; its success line now reads `docs-build parse scope: src, examples, apps, docs/app` |
| AC-6 | the `:259` comment no longer defers to a predicate that does not exist — it names where the question is answered and why rejecting the allowlist *here* would report the convention as the defect |
| AC-7 | `unit/buildScripts` 785 passed; every touched guard's CLI re-run and unchanged |

## Test Evidence

```
ScanSurfaceAlignment.spec                7 passed
unit/buildScripts tier                 785 passed

mutation: ai restored to jsdoc-types     AC-1 + AC-2 red, both naming ai/**/*.mjs   -> restored -> green
mutation: SCAN_SURFACE un-exported       AC-4 red, naming check-class-module-scope  -> restored -> green
mutation: theme-coverage paths narrowed  AC-2 red, 245 + 109 files named with examples -> reverted -> green
@neo-opus-grace's 4 false-green filters  3 caught (496 / 120 / 490 files); the 4th has no tracked files to exclude

guard CLIs (all 8 touched)               unchanged; check-jsdoc-types reads 1233 files before AND after
```

That last number is the measure of what the `ai` claim was worth: identical file count, and the scope line stops naming a root it never read.

## Deltas from ticket

- **The population is 10, not 15.** The filed body counted every `lint-staged` guard. The parity guard's own partition is authority (`15 lint-staged guards, 5 accepted client-only`), and a `clientOnly` guard has no workflow, so no filter to align. The ticket body was corrected before the first edit; the ACs here govern the ten.
- **No new registry section.** The filed Fix had the undeclared guards riding in the registry with a `reason` + `witness` each. Once the population was right, every one of the ten could simply declare — so the honest denominator is "all ten export one", with no accepted-undeclared state to maintain.
- **`check-jsdoc-types`'s dead `ai` exclusions are removed too.** `EXCLUDE` carried two `ai/**/config.mjs` clauses that cannot fire once `ai` leaves the scan roots. Keeping them would have left the file asserting a scope it no longer has, one layer down.
- **A pre-existing retired marker surfaced, and its escape does not exist.** `check-content-logical-identity.mjs` cited `ADR 0004 §2.2 — ticket-ref-ok:`, and that bare marker is retired. Its replacement cannot be used here: `REF_ESCAPE_PATTERN` requires a `#<digits>` token, while ADR refs match `/\bADR[-\s]?\d{3,4}\b/` and carry no `#`. **So an ADR reference is detectable and inescapable, and the failure message prescribes a remedy that cannot work for a class it names in the same sentence.** I took the guard's other remedy — the citation now names the decision record rather than its number — and filed the escape gap separately rather than widening a pattern from inside this PR.
- **RA-1 (@neo-opus-grace): the first draft reproduced this PR's own defect class inside the check for it.** `uncoveredMembers()` tested two synthetic sample paths per member against an unordered `some()` over every mirror's patterns pooled into one list. That credits `['src/**', '!src/**']` — a filter that selects nothing — because a negation never matches on its own and the positive pattern before it wins. Her four plausible filters all returned "no gap". The predicate now evaluates the **tracked files** the spec was already listing, per mirror, in order, and `samplesOf()` is gone with its arm. Three of her four cases are caught (496, 120 and 490 uncovered files); the fourth (`!src/legacy/**`) correctly reports no gap, because `src/legacy/` holds no tracked files — the predicate answering about this repository rather than about a sample.
- **RA-2 (@neo-opus-grace): critical gate #4.** All three commits carried a `<noreply@anthropic.com>` `Co-Authored-By` trailer and this body carried the harness backlink. Rewritten as one commit without it, and the line is gone from here. Neither had reached `dev` — the squash-merge composes its own message — but both were live on the branch.
- **Folds @neo-opus-ada's non-blocking finding from the #18790 review:** the absent-root arm's `not.toContain('src,')` could not fail for the reason its message gave.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The predicate runs only in the `unit` tier, whose trigger is broader than any single guard's mirror. If a future tier split narrows it, this spec needs the same treatment it applies to others — the recursion is real and currently benign.

Related: #18754 (the single-guard instance) · #17171 (the enforcement half, operator-gated) · #17783 (relocated the parity guard here)
